proposed_fixes.title: Investigate Win+R after Alt/Windows swap
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Windows may consume Win+R before Keyboard Manager applies the modifier remap, so the shell command misses the remapped chord.
plan: Reproduce swap and compare Win+R, Win+E, and explicit Alt+R-to-Win+R on current build.
Trace modifier-remap/shortcut flow and shell hotkey path to identify which component consumes the chord.
If PowerToys owns the missed path, correct dispatch and add focused coverage; otherwise document the OS boundary.
verification: Repeat all three variants and verify behavior on a supported build.
Run focused shortcut-remap tests and confirm Win+E and other remaps remain unchanged.
